Aragonese

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From Latin vōta (“vows”), plural of vōtum.

Noun

[edit]

boda f (plural bodas)

  1. wedding

References

[edit]
  • Bal Palazios, Santiago (2002), “boda”, in Dizionario breu de a luenga aragonesa, Zaragoza, →ISBN

  1. (Lagarteiru, Valverdeñu) wedding

Old English

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From Proto-West Germanic *bodō, from Proto-Germanic *budô. Related to Old English bēodan.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈbo.dɑ/
  • Rhymes: -o.dɑ

Noun

[edit]

boda m

  1. messenger
  2. prophet

Declension

[edit]

Weak:

singular plural
nominative boda bodan
accusative bodan bodan
genitive bodan bodena
dative bodan bodum

Descendants

[edit]
  • Middle English: bode
    • English: bode

Portuguese

[edit]

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • voda (archaic)

Etymology

[edit]

From Old Galician-Portuguese voda (“wedding”), from Latin vōta (“vows”), plural of vōtum (“vow”). Cognate with English vow. Doublet of voto and bodo.

Pronunciation

[edit]
 
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /ˈbo.dɐ/
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /ˈbo.dɐ/
    • (Southern Brazil) IPA(key): /ˈbo.da/
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /ˈbo.dɐ/ [ˈbo.ðɐ]

  • Audio (Brazil (Caipira)):(file)
  • Rhymes: -odɐ
  • Hyphenation: bo‧da

Noun

[edit]

boda f (plural bodas)

  1. wedding (marriage ceremony)
    Synonym: casamento

Derived terms

[edit]
  • bodas de ametista
  • bodas de coral
  • bodas de cristal
  • bodas de esmeralda
  • bodas de estanho
  • bodas de ouro
  • bodas de pérola
  • bodas de platina
  • bodas de porcelana
  • bodas de prata
  • bodas de rubi
  • bodas de zinco

Further reading

[edit]
  • “boda”, in Dicionário Aulete Digital (in Portuguese), Rio de Janeiro: Lexikon Editora Digital, 2008–2026
  • “boda”, in Dicionário Priberam da Língua Portuguesa (in Portuguese), Lisbon: Priberam, 2008–2026

Rohingya

[edit]

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • 𐴁𐴡𐴊𐴝 (boda) - Hanifi Rohingya script

Etymology

[edit]

Perhaps from Arabic بَيْضَة (bayḍa, “egg”). Compare Sylheti ꠛꠂꠖꠣ (boida, “egg”), Chittagonian বজা (boza, “egg”), Chakma 𑄝𑄧𑄘 (boda)

Noun

[edit]

boda (Hanifi spelling 𐴁𐴡𐴊𐴝)

  1. egg

Synonyms

[edit]
  • andha (compare Hindi अंडा (aṇḍā) / Urdu انڈا (aṇḍā, “egg”))
  • dhim (compare Bengali ডিম (ḍim, “egg”))

Spanish

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Inherited from Latin vōta (“vows”), plural of vōtum.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈboda/ [ˈbo.ð̞a]
  • Audio (Colombia):(file)
  • Rhymes: -oda
  • Syllabification: bo‧da

Noun

[edit]

boda f (plural bodas)

  1. (often in the plural) wedding
    Coordinate terms: nupcias, casamiento

Derived terms

[edit]
  • anillo de boda
  • boda de negros
  • bodas de diamante
  • bodas de ora
  • bodas de plata
  • bodas de platino
  • noche de bodas

Descendants

[edit]
  • → Cebuano: boda
  • → Chavacano: boda
  • → Sranan Tongo: boda
  • → Tagalog: boda

Further reading

[edit]
  • “boda”, in Diccionario de la lengua española [Dictionary of the Spanish Language] (in Spanish), online version 23.8.1, Royal Spanish Academy [Spanish: Real Academia Española], 15 December 2025

Sranan Tongo

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Probably borrowed from Spanish boda or less likely from Portuguese boda.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /boda/, [bʊ̞da̠], [bɔ̝dɑ̟]

Noun

[edit]

boda

  1. wedding
  2. party

Synonyms

[edit]
  • fesa

Tagalog

[edit]

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • bura — dialectal, Batangas

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Spanish boda, from Latin vōta (“vows”), plural of vōtum. Doublet of boto.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • (Standard Tagalog) IPA(key): /ˈboda/ [ˈboː.d̪ɐ]
  • Rhymes: -oda
  • Syllabification: bo‧da

Noun

[edit]

boda (Baybayin spelling ᜊᜓᜇ) (literary or dated)

  1. wedding
    Synonyms: kasal, pag-iisang dibdib, enlase, (Batangas) baysanan

Related terms

[edit]
  • boda de-diyamante
  • boda de-oro
  • boda de-plata
  • trahe de-boda

Further reading

[edit]
  • “boda”, in KWF Diksiyonaryo ng Wikang Filipino, Komisyon sa Wikang Filipino, 2025
  • “boda”, in Pambansang Diksiyonaryo | Diksiyonaryo.ph, 2018
